Perfect! **The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was in the state transition from S101. According to the spec, when tracking overlapping matches, if we're in state S101 (representing "101") and see a 0, we have "1010". The longest suffix of "1010" that is a prefix of "1011" is "10", so we should transition to S10, not IDLE. This preserves the overlap capability for patterns like "10101011" where the "10" suffix of one incomplete match becomes the start of the next pattern search.

The fix ensures proper overlapping match detection while maintaining all existing test behavior.
